title: SeoulCeuticals Korean Skin Care Korean- 20% Vitamin C Hyaluronic Acid Serum + CE Ferulic Acid - Potent Anti Aging, Anti Wrinkle Korean Beauty 1oz

reviews.reviewDescription: I’ve used a few other serums as a base before applying moisture and find this product to perform really well. Applies smoothly, absorbs well, and I’m noticing subtle improvements in the texture of my skin. A great value and love the results!!
I like this serum as a daily under-moisturizer layer. I think my skin is softer, brighter, and has fewer rough spots than before. I've added this to my routine and don't plan to stop any time soon.
I love this serum so much I am on my third bottle. It brightens my skin. The price is fair I love the citrus scent. It absorbs very well no stickiness.

reviews.reviewTitle: Glowing and hydrated skin. Not expected at all!
reviews.reviewDescription: Unfortunately I don't have pictures or videos. I've used a lot of skincare products, and most or all of them don't work as I expected, so I lost faith on miraculous products. Although after using this serum for some time (still using the first bottle), I've noticed a glowing skin, my skin with wrinkles improved noticeable, and I feel my face skin hydrated. I highly recomend this product. I definitely buy another bottle when I finish this one!
Excellent product, seems identical to CEFerulic by Skinceuticals at a drastically cheaper price, and it smells like orange, heavenly!
